This page lists 83 Adobe Animate keyboard shortcuts for macOS, grouped by area. They come from the community `animate.keyly` template for [Keyly](/), a free, open-source menu bar app: install the template once, then double-tap `⇪ Caps Lock` in Adobe Animate to see them next to the shortcuts Keyly reads from the app's menus.

## Install the template

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/main/scripts/install-templates.sh | bash -s -- -t animate.keyly
```

This saves the template to `~/.config/keyly/templates/animate.keyly`. It targets `/Applications/Adobe Animate 2024/Adobe Animate 2024.app`; if Adobe Animate lives elsewhere on your Mac, [update the app path](/configuration/templates/). New to Keyly? Start with [Getting Started](/getting-started/).

## File

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘R` | Import Image/Sound/etc |
| `⌥⇧⌘S` | Export Movie |
| `⌥⇧O` | Open as Library |
| `⌘N` | New document |
| `⌘O` | Open |
| `⌘S` | Save |
| `⇧⌘S` | Save As |
| `⌘W` | Close |
| `⌘Q` | Quit |

## View

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘1` | View at 100% |
| `⌘2` | Show Frame |
| `⌘3` | Show All |
| `⌘=` | Zoom in |
| `⌘-` | Zoom out |
| `⌘⌥R` | Show/Hide rulers |
| `⌘'` | Show/Hide grid |
| `⌘;` | Show/Hide guides |

## Edit

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘Z` | Undo |
| `⇧⌘Z` | Redo |
| `⌘X` | Cut |
| `⌘C` | Copy |
| `⌘V` | Paste |
| `⇧⌘V` | Paste in Place |
| `⌘D` | Duplicate |
| `⌘A` | Select All |
| `⇧⌘A` | Deselect All |
| `⌘G` | Group |
| `⇧⌘G` | Ungroup |
| `⌘B` | Break Apart |

## Arrange

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘↑` | Move Ahead |
| `⌘↓` | Move Behind |
| `⇧⌘↑` | Bring to Front |
| `⇧⌘↓` | Send to Back |

## Transform

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⇧⌘Z` | Remove Transform |
| `⌥⇧⌘S` | Scale and Rotate |
| `⇧⌘9` | Rotate 90° left |
| `⇧⌘7` | Rotate 90° right |

## Text

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌥←` | Narrower letterspacing |
| `⌥→` | Wider letterspacing |

## Panels

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘L` | Show/Hide Library |
| `⌘K` | Align Window |
| `⌘T` | Show/Hide Transform Panel |
| `⌥⌘T` | Show/Hide Timeline |
| `⌘F2` | Show/Hide Tools |
| `⌘F3` | Show/Hide Property Inspector |
| `⌘F9` | Show/Hide Actions |
| `⌘F10` | Show/Hide History |
| `⌘F11` | Show/Hide Color panel |

## Timeline

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘E` | Toggle Edit Movie/Symbol Mode |
| `F5` | Insert Frame |
| `F6` | Insert Keyframe |
| `F7` | Insert Blank Keyframe |
| `⇧F5` | Remove Frames |
| `⇧F6` | Clear Keyframe |
| `F8` | Convert to Symbol |

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⏎` | Play/Stop |
| `⌘⏎` | Test Movie |
| `⌘⌥⏎` | Test Scene |
| `,` | Previous Frame |
| `.` | Next Frame |
| `Home` | First Frame |
| `End` | Last Frame |

## Actions Panel

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌥⌘F` | Auto format code |
| `⌃⇧8` | Show hidden characters |
| `⌥⌘J` | Show Frame Script Navigator |
| `⌃⌥H` | Show tweening shape hints |

## Template file

The full [`animate.keyly`](https://github.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/blob/main/templates/animate.keyly) file. Copy it into `~/.config/keyly/templates/` to edit it, or [write your own](/configuration/custom-shortcuts/).
